text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The brilliance she displayed at the Japan Cup
was more than enough to prove her caliber—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Basking in that light, the young leaves sprouted
and soon began to slowly peek out.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Wait, this many new girls this semester?

text_block_list.name: Club Coach
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems there's an Umamusume who made
a huuuuge impact on them. Right, everyone?

text_block_list.name: Newly Joined Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Awesome...! That's the Cesario from the Japan Cup! She really is teaching us!

text_block_list.name: Newly Joined Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Of course I did!
That's why I joined in the first place...!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Th-th-th-th-thundering in...!
Cesario is here, Cesario is here! And!
GOOOOALLLL INNNN!!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
J-U-S-T as expected! Cesario won~~!
The strongest in the world is Cesario~~!!

text_block_list.name: Two Mothers
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
I told you playing with dolls had to wait until we got home!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“—And with that,
the Tracen Academy trial enrollment comes to an end.”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for today.
Please get home safely, okay?

text_block_list.name: Trial Participant Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yeeees!

text_block_list.name: Trial Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah, um...! Cesario-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Hm? Something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Trial Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I couldn't bring myself to say it all this time, but... um—!
I, I, I...!!

text_block_list.name: Trial Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Can I please... have your autograph...!

text_block_list.name: Trial Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
The way you ran was truly amazing.
It made me want to become just like you—

text_block_list.name: Trial Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: That's why taking the Tracen Academy entrance exam is also, um...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, of course!
I'll sign as many as you want—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I'm truly looking forward to your enrollment.
Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Achieve great feats on the Tiara route, and prove yourself fit to be a leader—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dreams spoken of in those innocent, youthful
days had brilliantly turned into reality.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Clothed in the aspirations of countless Umamusume, Cesario had become a 'Great Tiara Umamusume'—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: And so, they lived happily ever after—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: So, you don't have one yet, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Cesario's dream is...
to become a "cornerstone" in the far distant future.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Though those days were long and precious,
they were merely the prelude.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "There are countless things to be done, so many that even taking a breath feels wasteful, which is why—"
choice_data_list: Now, let's make some plans for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, yes. And after that—
choice_data_list: Review what needs to be done and get it organized.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Correct. ...And then?
choice_data_list: Shall we go out for eel tonight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Over these three years, I've reached the point where I can understand what she wants to say without her even speaking—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I wore a smug look, I got a gentle poke.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Better luck next time.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We're not done yet.
Tonight, I'd like to go eat your favorite food.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to say once again that I'm looking forward to working with you going forward.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...If it is you, I know without a doubt
you will realize the future I envision."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I feel that way even more vividly now than on the day you scouted me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Please take good care of my future students, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Be it the brilliance of the Triple Crown,
or perhaps the glory of being named the "strongest"—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: If it's you, I'm certain you can accomplish it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At those words, I suddenly
remembered a dream I had a long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: “—Crosses the finish line! Hands in the air!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A phenomenal final straight—
Leaving the trailing pack in the dust and pulling further ahead, a dominant 4-length victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Was I just carried away because it was the first day? About that vividly clear dream I had that day.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Realizing I hadn't told Cesario yet, I briefly explained it to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just a dream, yet a dream nonetheless.
I hope it brings some good luck for the future."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: And so, you called me, someone who has already retired from the front lines—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my, such a dream.
Ever since before your debut?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that is—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ahaha...! Oh, Trainer, really...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Cesario narrows her eyes—and giggles merrily, as if she were watching a comedy.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, forgive me.
It was just... so very you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful.
That's a truly wonderful dream.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, we shall fulfill it.
You and I, together."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Surely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes. —Everything up until now was merely a prologue.
The true story with her begins right here.
